title: ce-plan pipeline return
description: Machine-checked owner of the structured record ce-plan returns to a pipeline caller (LFG or any disable-model-invocation context) when it returns control after writing the plan, consumed by lfg's step-1 gate via `factory-gates.py validate`. Exactly four fields; the top level is strict (additionalProperties: false). The readiness *gate* (which readiness values may proceed) stays lfg prose — this schema only pins the structural shape.

plan_path.description: Path of the written plan file. On a blocked/failed return, the referenced input artifact path when one exists, otherwise an empty string.

doc_review_state.description: One-line string summary of the non-interactive ce-doc-review outcome (e.g. applied/proposed/decision counts), or the literal token 'skill_unreachable' when the documented skip envelope was recorded per references/plan-handoff.md.
